THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Lands described below are needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the Provisions of thatAct.

The allotments of land in extent of 0.1201 depicted in AdvanceTracing No. CO/DSO/2016/274 and dated 22.07.2016 prepared byColombo District Senior Survey General situated in the village ofMaradana Divisional Secretary's Division of Colombo in ColomboDistrict of Western Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Assmt. No. 191/1 to 191/21- Maradana Rd – Extent:0.0940 Hectare
North: Palliya watta and Walaw Watta;East: Palliya Watta andKalandar Sahib Jumma Mosque Premises; South: Kalandar SahibJumma Mosque Premises and Lot B; West: Palliya watta ( 940 Sq.meters).
02. Lot ‘B’ – Maulana Watta Rd – Extent: 0.0261 Hectare
North: Palliya watta and Lot A;East:Kalandar Sahib JummaMosque Premises and Kalil Hospital premises; South: Kalil Hospital
premises and Maradana Rd; West: Maulana Watta Rd. and Palliyawatta ( 261 Sq. meters).
Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
